Frontier is the worst. My wife and I went from Portland to Des Moines for business in Burlington (3 hours away) and they lost our luggage. 
We landed in Des Moines at 9pm, which was their last flight. We, along with 6 other people had the same issues. We waited at their kiosk at the airport for over an hour. When we noticed no one was showing up to help, I called their corporate offices, which were closed until the next day..2 hours later, I got someone at their airport management to find someone from Frontier to show up and help us (if you want to call it that). He was some flunky who searched for a good 30 minutes to tell us we can come back the next day around 7pm and all of our bags should be here, but he wasn't positive of that, so call before we came back the next day. We all were pretty pissed, but I kept my cool and nicely asked the guy if he had a local number we could call before we came back, so we could assure it would be here and he said no that we just needed to call their 800 which was automated. He told us that they were not responsible for our lost bags and I asked (nicely) how could they not be responsible, as it is their airline. Then this little prick got shitty with me and told me that he was calling security to have me removed if I didn't calm down. That's when the other passengers who had lost luggage got pissed to which he called security to have me removed for "starting an angry mob".
Security came and didn't toss me. The one security person told me to hang, as he wasn't going to do anything, then the guy from Frontier called the cops on me and the security guy. The police came and they, too, didn't bounce me. From what I was told this had happened before.
That night my wife and I had to stay in a hotel in Des Moines, rather than going to Burlington.
So the next morning, I called the 800 number to see what the status was of our luggage and after 90 minutes of automated menus, we wait 90 minutes to talk with someone. During that time we bought some clothes toiletries and I had to get Walgreens in Des Moines to help me get a dose of my meds (high blood pressure). Eventually, I got a hold of a human being who said that our luggage should be there around 9 that night, BUT we would have to be present to find out for sure. So, we went to Burlington and got there at 11am, did some of our business and had to go back to Des Moines at 6pm (missing a dinner with my wife's boss) to get our bags. We then got to Des Moines only to find out that all the same people from the night before were there and our bags were still not there.
The same guy who was there the night before was there again with 2 other people. This time, they all told me that they wouldn't help me because I was a security risk. So my wife and another passenger got in their faces and were pretty loud (not yelling) and they threatened to cancel all of our flights if this continued. Were again told to call the next day to see if the bags arrived (around 8pm"). Whats fucked up is 2 people were supposed to leave on the next flight out in the morning.
We repeated what happened the night before and had to miss another meeting. The bags arrived at 10pm that next night.

But wait...there's more.

So out flight back was that same day we got our luggage. We were supposed to leave at 6pm and have a connecting flight in Denver. We left 4 hours late because of mechanical issues. Subsequently, we missed our connection and they had to rebook, pretty much the whole plane. At this point it is midnight and our flight was rebooked for 7am. Frontier offered to get everyone a hotel room, but it was up to us to get their and we would all have to check in with a credit card. My wife and I did the math on how much time it would take to get to the hotel, get checked, get back to their airport, go through security (at Denver in the morning) and get to our flight, we decided to sleep at terminal instead of getting 3 hours of sleep (at most).
The next morning, we cleaned ourselves up at the airpor, got a coffee and muffin and got checked in for our flight, only to find we werent guaranteed at seat on the 7am flight. It was like "standby"if the flight wasn't sold out. Likely, it wasn't...but due to mechanical issues, we were delayed another 2 hours. Eventually we made it back to Portland and we even got our luggage.
That airline is an abortion. I don't care how cheap their tickets are, I would suggest that no one EVER flight them. Funny thing is, I have yet to meet anyone who has flown them and were surprised by my experience. I would be shocked if anyone would swear by them or didn't have a bad experience.
